title: Democrats BETRAY Eric Swalwell With SEX SCANDAL To STEAL CA Governor Race
tags: the culture war with tim pool
description:
Representative Eric Swalwell suspends his California governor campaign after multiple women accuse him of sexual misconduct, triggering a rapid collapse of support from top Democrats and staff resignations.

Swalwell denies the allegations and calls them false, but the scandal reshapes the race to replace Gavin Newsom as party leaders distance themselves and investigations begin.

The controversy now puts pressure on Democrats to contain the fallout and regroup quickly in an effort to stop a potential GOP sweep in California.
